purpose: Allow a fresh public-web ChatGPT client to verify exact package file identities without computing SHA256 locally.
client_pass_rule: PASS only when each exact path at package_commit is publicly reachable through GitHub public web/API metadata, each provider-returned blob SHA matches exactly, and the canary text matches exactly.
notes: SHA256 digests remain maintainer-side evidence but are not required from clients that cannot compute raw-byte SHA256.
Exact immutable package commit remains authoritative.
No private Human state is present or authorized by this proof.
